protocol.target: Suomi-NPP VIIRS reported detections per state-clipped 0.5 degree cell-month
protocol.backward_audit_status: Newly reserved for this experiment; not a guaranteed never-inspected test. Earlier published monthly artifacts include 2012.
protocol.spatial_audit: Fit only latitude <39.5 in all states, evaluate California latitude >=39.5, 2023-2025. Remove all training cells within 0.5 degrees of audit cells to prevent cross-state boundary leakage.
protocol.baseline: California training-only month-specific ratios; pooled-west model uses west training-only ratios; adapted model uses state ratios with global fallback.
protocol.candidate_selection: Select GAM penalty using mean California statewide monthly MAE across the two development folds. Select final model by California 2021-2022 monthly MAE. Baseline wins ties.
protocol.promotion_gate: At least 5% lower California selection monthly MAE than baseline AND selection cell-month MAE and north/south monthly MAE each no more than 5% worse than baseline. Known benchmark and backward/spatial audits are disclosed, never used for selection.
protocol.quality: Same vegetation/confidence predicate as v1; omit any paired month with listed MODIS or SNPP missing days. Missing/unavailable targets are never zeros.
protocol.exposure_policy: Hotspot-only acquisition/geometry features describe detected pixels, not observation exposure. Mask pilot is separate and is not fed into a full-period model unless matched coverage is available across its fitting and application periods.

manifest.ecoregion_assignment: Largest EPA Level III polygon intersection within each state-clipped cell, planar degree-area proxy.
limitations: Detection days/acquisitions are not observed clear-sky exposure.
Detection-pixel geometry is not geometry of all observations.
No land-cover time series acquired; static 2011 EPA regions are ecological proxies.
